reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message. The ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct) at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

One thing isn't confirmed. Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I'm treating it as the same account because the January handoff digest says Marrow Fieldworks, Pree's dealer account at the time, changed hands on 5 Jan. I suggested she check with Tobias before the call. I also told her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public team files. No approval was needed, since ticket numbers count as operational facts.
